notes: Images: look at several at once, in more formats (bmp, tiff, heic, svg) and big ones are shrunk for you, so it is faster and cheaper.
Mood boards and side-by-side comparisons: put many images on one sheet, or compare two versions with a map of what changed. They open in the preview panel.
Upscaler: make images 2x or 4x bigger. It can download the free Real-ESRGAN AI upscaler once (it asks you first); otherwise it does a plain high-quality resize.
